cohort: The study included 140 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants, with 70 exclusively fed donor milk and 70 randomly selected counterparts fed mother's own milk, all starting enteral feeding within 72 hours of birth.
finding: The study found no statistically significant differences in prematurity-related outcomes and complications between VLBW preterm infants fed donor milk compared to those fed mother's own milk.
